name: Wanderlust Oil
description: A compact cylindrical rollerball perfume oil vial with a brushed stainless steel body wrapped in a plain natural kraft-paper band, fitted with a stainless steel rollerball tip and collar for direct application.
materials: brushed stainless steel body, natural kraft-paper wraparound band, stainless steel rollerball tip and collar
primaryColors: brushed steel silver, natural kraft brown/tan
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, printing, logo, or lettering on the kraft-paper band or the steel body; never render a second rollerball tip or cap; never render the steel body as painted or colored, it must stay brushed silver metal; never add a spray nozzle; the kraft band must remain completely plain, unprinted paper. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the kraft-paper band's wraparound seam at the same position and the same plain, unprinted natural tan-brown paper texture across every angle; keep the brushed stainless steel body's fine linear brushed-metal texture and the rollerball tip/collar's polished steel finish consistent in every shot. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
